name: Ontology Registry Service Layer
description: Implement Phase 3 registry-service orchestration over the ontology registry store: pack registration, address reservation, activation rules, sync precondition reporting, internal wiring, tests, and docs updates without public routes or index-meta sync.

userStories.title: Define Ontology Registry Service Boundary
userStories.description: As a registry-service developer, I want an internal ontology registry service boundary so that lifecycle orchestration is separate from low-level store persistence.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `packages/registry-service/src/modules/ontology/ontology-registry.service.ts` or a similarly scoped internal service file.
Define service input/result types for `registerOntologyPack`, `reserveAddressSpace`, `activateAllocation`, and `syncToPrefixRegistry`.
Define service-level error/conflict types for invalid pack, invalid allocation plan, duplicate allocation, invalid transition, missing allocation, and sync precondition failure.
The service depends on `OntologyRegistryStore` and does not perform raw SQL directly.
The service does not expose REST controllers or CLI commands.
Add `operational-ontology` as a registry-service dependency if needed for pack validation/allocation projection.

userStories.title: Implement Pack Registration and Reservation
userStories.description: As a registry-service developer, I want pack registration to validate ontology packs and reserve address space so that invalid packs cannot create registry rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Method validates the pack with `validateOperationalOntologyPack()` before allocation.
Method projects the pack/schema into an allocation plan using `allocateOntologyAddressSpace()`.
Method validates the allocation plan with `validateOntologyAddressAllocationPlan()`.
Method persists only valid plans through `OntologyRegistryStore.writeAllocationPlan()`.
Invalid pack or invalid allocation plan leaves no namespace, axis, taxonomy, allocation, or segment rows.
Default `ontologyId` is `pack.packId` unless an explicit option overrides it.

userStories.title: Implement Reserve Address Space API
userStories.description: As a registry-service developer, I want a reserve API over existing allocation inputs so that service callers can reserve address space without activating it.
acceptanceCriteria: Method accepts schema/allocation policy inputs compatible with `allocateOntologyAddressSpace()`.
Reserved allocations are persisted with status `reserved`.
Duplicate prefix/version and duplicate ontology/taxonomy/version conflicts are surfaced as structured service errors.
Store errors are mapped without losing conflict details.

userStories.title: Implement Allocation Activation Rules
userStories.description: As a registry-service developer, I want allocation activation rules so that only valid reserved allocations can become active.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing allocation returns a structured missing-allocation error.
Activation is blocked if another active allocation has the same `(prefix, versionId)`.
Activation updates allocation status through the store boundary or an approved store method added for this transition.
The method does not call index-meta.

userStories.title: Add Sync-To-Prefix-Registry Precondition Shell
userStories.description: As a future index-meta sync implementer, I want a sync precondition/report shell so that Phase 4 can attach real sync behavior without changing Phase 3 APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Method requires the allocation to exist and be `active`.
Method returns a report payload with allocation id, prefix, version id, taxonomy id, status, and `syncStatus` indicating that real index-meta sync is deferred.
Missing or non-active allocation returns structured service errors.
Method does not write to index-meta, `prefix_registry`, or `schema_version`.
Report shape is documented for Phase 4.

userStories.title: Add Service-Layer Tests
userStories.description: As a registry-service maintainer, I want service tests for pack registration, reservation, activation, and sync preconditions so that lifecycle behavior is fixed before index-meta sync begins.
acceptanceCriteria: Test valid pack registration persists namespace, axis, taxonomy, allocation, and segment records.
Test invalid pack leaves no partial rows.
Test invalid allocation plan leaves no partial rows.
Test duplicate prefix/version reserve fails with structured conflict details.
Test missing, active-again, deprecated, and duplicate-active activation paths are rejected.
Test `syncToPrefixRegistry()` returns deferred sync report for active allocation and rejects non-active allocation.

userStories.title: Wire Internal Service into Registry-Service Module Boundary
userStories.description: As a registry-service integrator, I want the ontology registry service available inside registry-service so future modules can consume it without exposing public endpoints yet.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an internal Nest module/provider only if it matches existing registry-service module patterns.
Provider receives `ontologyStore` from bootstrap/store dependency wiring or a test-friendly factory.
No REST controller route is added.
Existing app/module startup tests continue to pass.
Add a focused module/provider test if the service is wired through Nest.

userStories.title: Reflect Phase 3 Completion in Docs and TODO
userStories.description: As an ontology documentation maintainer, I want Phase 3 completion reflected in specs and TODO so that Phase 4 can start from a stable active allocation contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `operational-ontology-registry-allocation.todo.md` to mark Phase 3 service layer items complete.
Update `operational-ontology-registry-allocation.spec.md` to summarize the service methods and lifecycle rules.
Update `operational-ontology-registry-persistence-handoff.spec.md` if service error naming refines the handoff contract.
Keep Phase 4 index-meta sync items open.
Update `tasks/prd-ontology-registry-allocation-lifecycle-master.md` with the Phase 4 execution PRD path if it is created.
